verdict.rationale: Brex exposes webhooks for event notifications and lets admins define spend/approval policy rules (auto-enforced limits, multi-level approval routing, AI review agent that auto-approves or escalates based on rule violations), which together enable event-triggered automated actions. However there's no documented end-to-end workflow builder linking arbitrary webhook events to custom actions—automation is limited to built-in policy/approval triggers rather than a general rules engine. Missing for 10: a user-configurable rule engine that maps arbitrary webhook events to arbitrary actions, and independent confirmation the webhook+policy combo works as a full automation pipeline.
